pit_lane.coordinates: pit rows native metres (sourceX,-sourceY); drive surface Blender metres; barriers native units x17
pit_lane.height: pit-route EA 1 m lidar DTM, 12 m smoothing, bounded grades and original GP joins; deck/contact top physical + 0.065 m
pit_lane.gp_road_protection: authored white-line legal area plus original road/line/kerb footprints; 5 mm rounding margin; no pit cut, deck or paint inside

national_pit.source: OSM 227838385/507989196 and original National buildings; estimated six-metre fast lane; GP white lines unchanged

pit_lane.entry_rail_opening: Four terminal pieces of mapped access rail 899965299 recessed about 11 m; original GP pitwall 899233533 unchanged
pit_lane.apron_height: 3 m physical blend plus 0.065 m contact offset; 1 m outer visual collar meets unchanged original contact heights
pit_lane.wing_height: original XY/UVs; common longitudinal vertical correction for every Wing part, with only ground floor faces added to contact
limitations: OSM alignment, nominal 8.5 m width with measured corridor pinches, and index 10..56 controlled zone are provisional, not a pit engineering survey
Portal cuts are limited to transverse original barriers before speed entry or after speed exit
Affected custom-LOD tiles abort rather than silently replacing their LODs
Parent must consume pit_barriers.bin only when barrier_override_enabled and append Chapel closure
Rerun after add_details: regenerated detail contacts can otherwise overlap the deck
Importers must reconcile retired Tile_Pit meshes when the recipe changes
